title: Dispatch: 19.3.3 repair after Sol 19.3.3.4 S1 (attempt 3)
description: Repair PR #652 per Sol review eshyra-o9bd.19.3.3.4 S1 (read in full incl. sibling analysis and closure). This is the SECOND repair of the language-identity class (prior: 19.3.3.3 S2), so close the class at EVERY boundary, not just the reproducer: the bounded identity languageKey (trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase) must be the one identity used by creation validation, class-feature language choices derived at creation (deriveCreationClassChoices input, characterDraft.ts ~:889; Ranger Favored Enemy/Natural Explorer language picks), finalization (finalizeCharacter.ts collectLanguages/feature merge ~:1075-1084), the shared language descriptor validation, and progression consumers of the durable sheet (levelUpFeatureChoices.ts ~:457/:614/:728). Preferred shape: canonicalize at the producer - when a selected or approved language's languageKey equals a known canonical language name (default domain, fixed grants, SRD language tables), persist the canonical spelling; otherwise persist the whitespace-collapsed trimmed spelling - AND make every comparison boundary use languageKey, so an already-known language is never offered/accepted again and the sheet never stores two variants. Preserve explicit approvals, Standard default domains, required-grant quantities, and the sheet string-array shape; never silently dedupe a required grant after accepting an invalid choice. Cover ordinary and custom-background producers and saved drafts. Permanent evidence: one compact generalized invariant over canonical/case/whitespace equivalents through real bundled Ranger creation (Favored Enemy language) and durable-sheet level-up consumption, for ordinary and custom approved producers, plus a distinct-language control. Grep for every other language comparison in packages/core/src and packages/cli/src and report each in notes (aligned or why not). Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes: S1 root cause: the bounded languageKey identity (trim/collapse/lowercase) was used only by creation validation (characterDraft); the class-feature known-language input, finalization feature merge and level-up consumers used raw strings or lowercase-only, so 'Deep  Speech' approved at ancestry left canonical 'Deep Speech' offered/acceptable again and the sheet stored both. Change: new languageIdentity.ts (languageKey, canonicalLanguageName, SRD exotic table constant); producer canonicalization in finalize collectLanguages (fixed grants and picks persist canonical spelling when key matches Standard/Exotic tables, fixed grants, choice domains or class-feature taught languages, else trimmed collapsed spelling; collision with an already-held identity still throws, never silently dedupes a required grant) and canonicalHeldLanguages feeding deriveCreationClassChoices (identity-distinct, canonical); consumers aligned: levelUpFeatureChoices listDescriptor held filter, validation of languageChoice picks, applyLanguagesToSheet dedupe; CLI promptGmApprovedLanguage compare. Boundary table: creation validation languageKey (already); custom-bg validation languageKey (already); isLanguageChoiceSatisfied languageKey (already); class-feature known languages -> canonicalHeldLanguages + languageKey filter (fixed); finalize collectLanguages/feature merge -> languageKey (fixed); level-up held filter/pick validation/applyLanguagesToSheet -> languageKey (fixed); CLI wizard other-language: whitespace collapse + identity compare (aligned); domain membership checks (domain.has/from) intentionally exact: out-of-domain spelling needs approval; no other language comparisons in core/cli src (grepped toLowerCase/languages). Evidence: languageExtensionPoint.test.ts new describe: 4 spellings x ordinary/custom producers through real Ranger Favored Enemy (not offered, forced pick refused, one canonical sheet entry, level-6 detector excludes), raw-spelling durable sheets + applyLanguagesToSheet dedupe, distinct-language control. 8 of the new cases fail without the src change.
